name: ModelVariant649Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant649us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (spinning petals spread along the line between two joints while a textured dome grows over the model, then a card flies to the midpoint of two other joints with spiralling shards and sparks); for a non-negative request it prints the work size, packs four textures from the image table and seeds the petals, dome, card and shards from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-666/733 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant666_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, without the work-size printf, and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
